name: qacademy-api-tests
description: Postman/Newman API tests for the QAcademy training platform

scripts.test: newman run postman/qacademy-team2.postman_collection.json -e postman/qacademy-team2.postman_environment.json --reporters cli,htmlextra,junit,json --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "QAcademy team 2 - API tests" --reporter-junit-export reports/junit.xml --reporter-json-export reports/newman.json --timeout-request 30000
